description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art head, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Inside the white of the mask, cover the whole head, face and ears included, with the same big carved jack-o'-lantern pumpkin worn like a helmet, a little larger than the head and resting at the chin: bright orange with broad dark ribs, two triangle eyes and a jagged grinning mouth carved in its front showing warm yellow inside, and a short green stem with one curled vine leaf on top. Seen from behind, the plain ribbed back of the pumpkin and its stem, no face. Nothing of the bald head, the face or the ears shows. Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour, no glow, nothing else added, transparent background.
